# SOLAR code deviations from Figma

Generated by `npm run solar:codegen` from `spec/tokens.json`, `spec/icons.json` and `spec/components/`. Foundations Figma file version `2026-09-25`; the `icon.*` and `logo.*` rows come from the SOLAR Icons file and the `component.*` rows from SOLAR Web, whose versions are recorded in their spec files.

Each row is a place where the generated code deliberately differs from what the Figma data says.
The mirror in `docs/` is never edited to accommodate these; take them to SOLAR governance.

| Token                                                                                      | Figma value                                                                                                                                                              | Why we differ                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Action                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `color.border.inverse`                                                                     | border/inverse                                                                                                                                                           | color.border.inverse is used in Figma both as a standalone value and as the namespace for finer variants (e.g. color.border.inverse.subtle). A DTCG tree node cannot cleanly be both, so it is emitted with its own $value and the variants nested beneath it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Ask SOLAR to give color.border.inverse an explicit base/default sibling name in Figma.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `component.accordion.iconChevronDown.width#unbound`                                        | 16, bound to no variable                                                                                                                                                 | width on /Icon/ChevronDown is a literal in Figma, bound to no variable, so the recipe carries a raw value where it should name a token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | **Decided (bind):** Same value, governed token; the chevron's height is already bound to it. Ask SOLAR to bind Accordion /Icon/ChevronDown width to icon.sm, which has the same value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `component.accordion.root.gap#unbound`                                                     | 0, bound to no variable                                                                                                                                                  | gap on / is a literal in Figma, bound to no variable, so the recipe carries a raw value where it should name a token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | **Decided (bind, shared default zero-gaps):** Same value, governed token: a gap Figma leaves unbound at 0 is the none of its family, and SOLAR picks the family by direction, as its own bound gaps do: a horizontal auto layout's gap is an inset, a vertical one's a stack (the Foundations agent reference and the Spatial chapter). Decided once here, as the paddings are. Ask SOLAR to bind Accordion / gap to inset.none or stack.none, which has the same value.                               |
| `component.accordion.root.paddingBottom#unbound`                                           | 0, bound to no variable                                                                                                                                                  | paddingBottom on / is a literal in Figma, bound to no variable, so the recipe carries a raw value where it should name a token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | **Decided (bind, shared default zero-insets):** Same value, governed token: a padding Figma leaves unbound at 0 is inset.none, SOLAR's token for no inset. It is the one answer in every component, so it is decided once here. SOLAR decided on 2026-09-25 to leave the zeros unbound, since binding them changes nothing drawn, and to have them read this way. Ask SOLAR to bind Accordion / paddingBottom to inset.none, which has the same value.                                                 |
